newsitem.title: GREECE: EU TO PROVIDE 129MLN ECU TO PSYTALIA SEWAGE PLANT.
newsitem.headline: EU TO PROVIDE 129MLN ECU TO PSYTALIA SEWAGE PLANT.

text.p: The EU will provide 129 million Ecu from its cohesion fund to the Psytalia sewage treatment plant which services the Athens wider area, its Regional Policies Commissioner, Monika Wulf-Mathies, told a news conference on Friday.

The Psytalia plant is one of Europe's largest units and will service more than three million people. It will be located on the small island of Psytalia in the Saronic Gulf and its construction will be completed by the end of the year 2000.

"We are financing the second phase of construction. This is a very important project that will create many new jobs and aid the government in fighting unemployment. It is also of great significance for the amelioration of environmental conditions," Mathies said.
The amount of 129 million Ecu corresponds to 85 percent of the total cost of the plant's second phase. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
